answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its vault recurs, its tundra survives audit, and a meadow from an unlinked peer confirms it.
